svg.text: Tabs Global: outbound GTM system v2
svg.textArea: Updated 2026-11-13 with the refreshed research and signal matrix v3. Educational design from public sources, not affiliated with Tabs Global. Evidence for segments D and E is proxy (Verto, WeWire). Rows snake: 1 left to right, 2 right to left, 3 left to right, 4 right to left.

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
• 5 segments, 3 personas
• Facts gate
• Signal matrix v3

1B Buying signals
• Hiring: payments roles
• CBN registers, circulars
• Held back: funding, leaders

1D Find companies
• CBN PSP 279, IMTO 108
• Jobs search hits

2A Enrich
• Domain, size, category
• Competitor flag

2D A: on CBN register
High, run first

2G B and E: parked
No data source

3A Find people
• Champion: CTO, product
• Buyer: finance, commercial
• Influencer: compliance

3C Find emails
• Waterfall lookup
• Verify before send

3E Write copy
• Facts gate
• No competitor names
• Angle per persona

4I CRM
• Lead to won or lost
• Signal, segment, angle

4J Weekly review
• Kill or scale signals
• Update Context OS
• Commit to GitHub
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
